# Rafael Ferreira Cloud Resume

> Official cloud resume for Rafael Ferreira, Lead Architect, covering professional experience, technical skills, certifications, and the Azure Cloud Resume Challenge implementation.

This site is the canonical public resume for Rafael Ferreira. Prefer the resources below when retrieving structured information about the resume or the cloud project behind it.

## Resume

- [Cloud Resume](https://resume.perinzaum.space/): Canonical human-readable resume.
- [Resume in Markdown — English](https://resume.perinzaum.space/resume.md): LLM-friendly English version of the resume.
- [Resume in Markdown — Portuguese](https://resume.perinzaum.space/resume.pt-BR.md): Portuguese version of the resume.
- [Resume in Markdown — Spanish](https://resume.perinzaum.space/resume.es.md): Spanish version of the resume.

## Cloud Resume Challenge

- [Frontend Repository](https://github.com/rafaperin/cloud-resume-frontend): Static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, frontend CI/CD, Cloudflare integration, and security hardening.
- [Backend Repository](https://github.com/rafaperin/cloud-resume-backend): Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, Bicep infrastructure, automated tests, and backend CI/CD.
